tokens.name: ow-canvas
tokens.usage: The app's background behind surfaces. Dark is the night ground.

tokens.name: ow-paper
tokens.usage: Marketing pages' ground, under the dot grid. Warm in light: don't put slate controls on it beside slate surfaces.

tokens.name: ow-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, fields, dialogs and menus.

tokens.name: ow-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Hover rows, ghost-button hover, keys and quiet fills inside a surface.

tokens.name: ow-control
tokens.usage: Top of the secondary button's and ChoiceCard's gradient.

tokens.name: ow-control-shade
tokens.usage: Bottom of the secondary button's and ChoiceCard's gradient.

tokens.name: ow-control-shade-hover
tokens.usage: Bottom of the secondary button's gradient on hover.

tokens.name: ow-hover
tokens.usage: The keyboard-active or hovered option in a select's listbox.

tokens.name: ow-disabled
tokens.usage: The flat grey fill of a disabled primary or danger button.

tokens.name: ow-icon
tokens.usage: Decorative icons beside text: a select's chevron, inactive nav icons. 2.6:1 on white in light, kept from the source; never the only sign of anything.

tokens.name: ow-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and dialog edges, dividers, menu borders.

tokens.name: ow-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 1.5:1 on white in light, kept from the source; fields also carry a label.

tokens.name: ow-border-hover
tokens.usage: A hovered control's border.

tokens.name: ow-text
tokens.usage: Headings, labels and values on ow-surface, ow-surface-muted and ow-canvas (17.8:1 light, 15.0:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ow-text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary button labels and badge text on ow-control and ow-surface-muted.

tokens.name: ow-text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, hints, placeholders and captions on every surface and the canvas (5.4:1 on white, 4.9:1 on canvas; 5.9:1 on dark surface, 5.1:1 on dark muted).

tokens.name: ow-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only; exempt from contrast minimums, so never use it for anything people must read.

tokens.name: ow-primary
tokens.usage: Primary fill: top of the primary button's gradient, checked boxes, switches on, avatar initials ground. ow-on-primary on it: 11.7:1 light, 6.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: ow-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Bottom of the primary button's gradient; checked boxes on hover.

tokens.name: ow-primary-active
tokens.usage: The primary button's and a checked box's border.

tokens.name: ow-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ow-primary and ow-primary-hover.

tokens.name: ow-primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary-coloured text and icons on surfaces: the selected option's check, a ChoiceCard's icon, active nav icons (11.7:1 light, 8.9:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ow-primary-subtle
tokens.usage: The active command in the palette, the recommended choice's icon tile, the active badge.

tokens.name: ow-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Stronger primary tint for selected states.

tokens.name: ow-primary-border
tokens.usage: Borders of primary-tinted things: the recommended ChoiceCard, the active badge, icon tiles.

tokens.name: ow-primary-focus
tokens.usage: An open select's border.

tokens.name: ow-focus-border
tokens.usage: A focused field's border (6.3:1 on white; 5.3:1 on dark surface).

tokens.name: ow-focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2 px keyboard focus outline on every control, offset 2 px. At least 3:1 on every surface and the canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ow-brass
tokens.usage: The accent, kept small: chip dots, list bullets, the dot grid under the pointer, a star. A graphic colour on light grounds (2.1:1); text only on dark (7.3:1 on dark surface).

tokens.name: ow-brass-deep
tokens.usage: Brass you can read: link hover and brass text on ow-surface and ow-paper (5.1:1 and 4.8:1 in light; 7.3:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ow-brass-soft
tokens.usage: Brass tint behind ow-brass-deep: notes, placeholders, half marks.

tokens.name: ow-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Bottom of the danger button's gradient, checked danger boxes (red-600). White on it: 4.8:1.

tokens.name: ow-danger-fill-border
tokens.usage: The danger button's border (red-700).

tokens.name: ow-danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and danger badge text on ow-surface and ow-danger-surface (6.4:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).
